title: {Syn} Backpropagation Made Deep Learning Trainable
content:
Backpropagation efficiently computes gradients in layered networks by applying the chain rule backward through the computation graph.

The method is older than the recent deep learning wave, but its combination with data, accelerators, and better architectures made modern neural networks practical.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
